fact: A June 2026 journal article, from interviews in April 2025 to February 2026, says each land administration has its own information system with no integrated database, the e-Conservation platform set up in 2023 is cloisonné from the cadastre platforms, and many communes keep paper archives.
title: Gouvernance foncière face à l'urgence de la réforme à N'Djamena, cité-capitale du Tchad
publisher: Annales de l'Université de Moundou, Série A - AFLASH
